tweet.text:
You can't convince anyone of the truth. They have to see it for themselves. They won't see it because of you. You may show them the door. It will be their decision to walk through it.

The only people I have been able to convince are those who watched me stand firm for years. Did their own research and came to me later and said holy shit you were right.

We all take our own time and require different things to deprogram ourselves. It takes time and effort. It is not fun or easy for anyone.
